panels.scene: Dana in her home office far away, sitting at a desk, phone to her ear, relaxed, a coat and small suitcase by the door. Top third plain wall.
dialogue: I'll be there Thursday. Anything you need?

panels.scene: Walt at his garage workbench beside a bicycle on a stand, phone at his ear, grinning, wrench in his other hand. Top third plain pegboard wall with no tools hanging high.
dialogue: Bring your appetite. And your chess game.

panels.scene: Dana and Walt sitting across a kitchen table over a chess set, both smiling, mugs beside them, the small green stovetop kettle on the stove behind them. Top third plain wall.
panels.caption: A visit can just be a visit.
